mechanism: The test imports startBridge by a relative path into mote-final-check/packages/agent/dist, while the test and DelegationRuntime import ContextToolError through @mote/agent.
The shared node_modules worktree link resolves @mote/agent into main/mote/packages/agent/dist. Dist bytes match but these are different ESM module URLs and therefore distinct class constructors.

The bridge imports ContextToolError from its own relative tool-errors.js and preserves a typed error only when error instanceof ContextToolError. A main-worktree ContextToolError is not an instance of the candidate bridge class.
The code path therefore selects generic context_tool_failed for that cross-module error. This is a code-derived consequence; the original suite failure detail is retained by the root driver.

Redirecting @mote/agent and @mote/shared package exports to the same frozen candidate package dist only in one child process makes the constructors identical; the unchanged real HTTP test passes all declared-bound, corrective-error and valid-call assertions.
